pool.text: A Portuguese captain-general commanded a military expedition sent by the Governor General.
The Kingdom of Portugal founded Belem as the first European colony.
Captain-general Francisco Caldeira Castelo Branco anchored in Guajara Bay.
Belem was officially given city status.
Belem was made capital of the State when Para state split.
Belem officially became part of Brazil.
Uprisings and internecine strife finally ended after considerable loss of life.
The position of Belem was enhanced by the opening of rivers.
Neoclassical architecture was included in buildings such as the Theatro da Paz.
The cathedral Igreja da Se was founded as one of Brazil's largest.
The Universidade Federal do Pará was established in the city.
The municipality of Belem contains the Utinga State Park created to protect water.
The municipality was divided into administrative districts and neighborhoods based on municipal law.
The World Social Forum took place in Belem.
Belem has been part of the UNESCO Creative Cities Network in gastronomy.
Protásio de Oliveira Airport was taken out of service.
